Name: Sebastian portrait by Gingerbelley
Author: Gingerbelley
Description:
[size=3]How to install:[/size]
- download Portraiture mod.
- create a folder in "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" and name the folder however you like (for example "Gingerbelley portraits") and drop the .png image file the portrait files inside it.
- use "P" to switch between portraits and enjoy!

[u][size=4]FAQ:
[/size][/u][size=3]
[/size][size=3]Why is my portrait not working?[/size]

- Make sure that the file name starts with a capital letter, for example, it should be "Sebastian.png" NOT "sebastian.png". If for some reason the file name changed into a lower case letter, please [u]RENAME[/u] them accordingly. When I uploaded the files I made sure the name of the files were correct, but somehow to appeared wrong for some people who downloaded it, and that could effect the Portraiture mod [It will not line up with the file it's supposed to replace (aka. vanilla portraits) if you do not name the HD portraits you download correctly.]

- Make sure you have the LATEST version of Portraiture, and follow their instructions accordingly.

- DO NOT skip this step below

[i][u]"create a folder in "Mods/Portraiture/Portraits" and name the folder however you like (for example "Gingerbelley portraits") and drop the .png image file the portrait files inside it."[/u]
[/i]
A few people that have messaged me skipped this step, causing Portraiture not to work. See Portraiture's instructions on the details.

- If doing all of the above still doesn't fix it, shoot me a message on my socials, I'm no programmer, I'm just an artist but I'll do my best to help.

Happy Modding!
